reviews.text: They provide attentive and caring examinations and treatments.

My dog ​​has always had sensitive skin since he was a puppy, and he often developed bumps on his belly... Our regular vet was closed, so we came here.

At our regular vet, they treated it with medication, but here they introduced us to skincare treatments using shampoos and other products to improve his skin condition, and thanks to that, the time between bouts has been extended ✨

I think I'll come back again if I have the chance.
Best vet ever! So supportive and helpful!

This is the regular care for my two very small dogs with heart problems.
They helped me when I thought there was no hope, such as with tamponade and heart failure, and I trust them very much.
Unfortunately, one of our dogs has passed away, but thanks to the vet and animal nurses who explained his condition and treatment thoroughly, we were able to provide satisfactory treatment and care for him at the end.
When he passed away, they provided angel care and sent flowers, so I feel this is a veterinary hospital that is close to the hearts of pet owners.

This is a truly wonderful animal hospital.

My cat, Mameka, had cystitis, but the doctors here examined and treated her very carefully, and thanks to them, she has made a full recovery.

Yesterday, Mameka arrived in London in good health. She drank water immediately after being let out of her cage, used the litter box normally, and is very healthy.

I am deeply grateful to the doctors and staff for their kind and attentive care, from treatment to travel preparations.

Thank you so much.

This is a very trustworthy hospital.
The staff here are so thoughtful and experienced!

We've been taking care of our dog since he was a puppy. It started as a privately owned business, but it seems to have become part of an animal hospital group now. The staff consists of a kind and excellent female director and a very caring nurse. Our dog passed away from an illness, but they took excellent care of him until the very end, and even arranged his body beautifully after his death, so he was able to depart in a dignified state. You can really feel that everyone there loves animals, and I think you can entrust your precious pets to them with peace of mind.

The day before yesterday, I said goodbye to my beloved cat, who was 18 and a half years old (tears). I am so grateful to the doctor for being so kind to us. The doctor's gentle touch and warm voice comforted both my cat and me so much. We were also saved by the cheerful attitude of the staff. I express my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you so much.
The explanations are thorough and the examinations are accurate! And the prices are reasonable.
